entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I was so excited for these cycling shoes, I've been a loyal customer for years. I just... I really needed these to work out.

Okay, I see the order for the Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered on January 14th. It looks like you've had them for about nine days. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I tried them on one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They're just not the right shape for my foot, and I couldn't get the cleats to feel secure. It's just... a shame. I saved up for these and now I can't even use them.
I understand completely. Getting blisters is the worst, and the fit is the most important part of any cycling shoe. I really appreciate you explaining that. Let me just check our policy here.
Okay, yes. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I'll just email you a pre-paid shipping label right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried because I really needed that money back.

It's no problem at all. We want you to be happy with your gear. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
You've been a huge help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
